description: This grouped bar chart, which is visually presented at a tilted, clockwise angle, illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by different model configurations across various datasets. The logical horizontal category axis, labeled "Dataset," displays six categories in the following order from left to right: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The logical vertical value axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)," uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 10. Within each dataset category, the chart features a group of four adjacent bars representing different model configurations, as defined by the legend positioned below the chart. The green bars represent "MADLLM," the purple bars represent "MADLLM w/o feature embedding," the blue bars represent "MADLLM w/o prompt pool," and the orange bars represent "MADLLM w/o skip embedding." The approximate values of the bars vary across the datasets, with the tallest bar being the green "MADLLM" bar in the SMAP category, reaching approximately 100%, and the shortest bar being the purple "MADLLM w/o feature embedding" bar in the WADI category, at approximately 62%. The dataset categories on the horizontal axis do not appear to be sorted in alphabetical order or by ascending or descending bar heights. All bars are outlined in black, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color coding.
